headline: Why your lip tint looks patchy by lunch

scenes.say: Why does your lip tint look patchy by lunch? It's usually dry lips, not the tint.
First, a thin layer of lip balm. Wait one minute, then blot it off with a tissue.
scenes.label: Step 1

scenes.say: Next, tap the tint only on the inner half of your lips.
scenes.label: Step 2

scenes.say: Blend it outward with your fingertip, so the edge fades softly.
scenes.label: Step 3

scenes.say: The common mistake? Lining the whole lip first. That hard edge is what fades unevenly.
scenes.label: Skip this
